data.name: Manglesh
data.long_meaning: The name Manglesh is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Mangal’ meaning moon and ‘Ish’ meaning lord. The name Manglesh is thus a compound of these two words and means ‘Moon-given’ or ‘Moon-bestowed’. The second part of the name, ‘Lesh’, comes from the Sanskrit root ‘Las’ meaning to nourish or to bring up. Thus, the name Manglesh can be interpreted to mean ‘Moon-given, Earth-born’ or ‘Moon-nourished, Earth-born’. This name is often given to a child born during a lunar eclipse or during a full moon night.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Manglesh holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. The word ‘Mangal’ means moon, which is considered a symbol of the divine energies of the universe. The word ‘Ish’, which is the second part of the name, is a common suffix in many Hindu names and is a reflection of the deep spiritual connection that the name-bearer has with the divine. The name Manglesh thus represents the spiritual journey of an individual, who is trying to connect with the divine energies of the universe and seeks to be bestowed with the blessings of the moon god. The name also symbolizes the harmony between the spiritual and material worlds, as represented by the combination of the moon (spiritual) and the earth (material).
